_comment: Real estate platform install of the email-campaigns skill. Drop into a residential brokerage / listings site. Pulls in all the same surfaces (welcome, order/transactional, admin notice, unsubscribe) but with vertical-appropriate copy. After copying, see ./README.md for the 3-place install checklist.

reservation.location: Showing address provided in the listing details
reservation.qr_caption_es: Muestra este código al agente al llegar
reservation.qr_caption_en: Show this code to the agent on arrival

newsletter_welcome.intro_es: Ya estás en la lista de {{brand_name}}. Te enviaremos lo que de verdad importa:
newsletter_welcome.intro_en: You're on the {{brand_name}} list. We'll send you what actually matters:
bullets_es: Nuevas propiedades en las zonas que sigues
Resumen de open houses del fin de semana
Reportes mensuales del mercado y tendencias de precios
Oportunidades off-market antes de salir publicadas
bullets_en: New listings in your saved neighborhoods
Monthly market reports and pricing trends
Off-market opportunities before they go public
newsletter_welcome.secondary_cta_label_es: O agenda una llamada con un agente
newsletter_welcome.secondary_cta_label_en: Or book a call with an agent

unsubscribe_page.success_message_template_es: Ya no recibirás emails de marketing de {{brand_name}}. Tu cuenta y favoritos siguen activos.
unsubscribe_page.success_message_template_en: You won't receive marketing emails from {{brand_name}}. Your account and saved properties remain active.

order_emails._comment: For real estate, 'order' maps to 'transaction' — a signed offer, deposit, or closing. 'tracking' becomes 'closing status update'. 'refund' is a deposit return after a deal falls through. 'abandoned_cart' is a started-but-not-submitted offer.

confirmation.intro_es: Recibimos tu oferta y la estamos revisando con el vendedor. Te avisaremos en cuanto haya respuesta — normalmente en 24-48 horas.
confirmation.intro_en: We've received your offer and we're reviewing it with the seller. We'll be in touch as soon as we hear back — usually within 24-48 hours.
confirmation.outro_es: Si tienes alguna pregunta, responde a este correo o llama a tu agente.
confirmation.outro_en: If you have any questions, reply to this email or call your agent.

tracking.intro_es: Aquí tienes el estado actual de tu cierre y los próximos pasos.
tracking.intro_en: Here's the current status of your closing and the next steps.
tracking.outro_es: ¡Casi lo logramos! Cualquier duda, responde a este correo.
tracking.outro_en: Almost there! Any questions, just reply to this email.

refund.intro_es: Procesamos la devolución de tu depósito. Debería reflejarse en tu cuenta en 5–10 días hábiles según tu banco.
refund.intro_en: We've processed the return of your deposit. It should appear in your account within 5–10 business days depending on your bank.
refund.outro_es: Sentimos que esta transacción no se concretara. Cuando estés listo/a, aquí estamos.
refund.outro_en: Sorry this one didn't work out. Whenever you're ready, we're here.

abandoned_cart.heading_en: Your offer is still in draft
abandoned_cart.intro_es: Empezaste una oferta pero no llegaste a enviarla. Las propiedades buenas no esperan — termina cuando puedas.
abandoned_cart.intro_en: You started an offer but didn't submit it. Good properties don't wait — finish whenever you can.
abandoned_cart.outro_es: Vuelve a {{brand_domain}}/offers para retomar o responde si necesitas hablar con un agente.
abandoned_cart.outro_en: Head back to {{brand_domain}}/offers to pick up, or reply if you'd like to talk to an agent.

admin_new_order.intro_en: A buyer just submitted an offer. Details below.

admin_refunded.intro_en: A deposit was returned on the transaction below.
